observed.after_sign_in: navigated to /chat/deadbeef...deadbeef, the original deep-link target

checks.check: cold deep-link bootstrap against a channel the relay does not have

observed.rendered: 'Channel could not be loaded — This channel is not on the relay. It may have been removed, or the link may be wrong.'

checks.verdict: PASS — a definitive negative answer, reached without waiting on a clock. The previous eight-second timer fallback would have resolved this as a success; the page instead names a true terminal failure state and distinguishes 'the relay does not have this' from 'still loading'.

checks.check: channel counts decreasing after a deletion
checks.reason: Driving a deletion needs signed kind-42 and kind-5 events. Minting them requires secp256k1 Schnorr signing, and no Node signing library is installed in this container; the relay also gates writes on NIP-42 AUTH plus the whitelist. The reconciliation logic is covered by unit tests over crates/nostr-bbs-forum-client/src/utils/reconcile.rs (removals before appends, survivor order and per-item reactive identity preserved).
checks.observed_partial: The channel header renders derived counts ('0 messages · 0 members') from the store snapshot rather than an append-only accumulator, which is the shape the fix requires.

urls: http://agentbox:8082/profile/<pk> (every endpoint on a closed port)

observed.freshness_label: 'checked just now' rendered beside the Badges heading in both runs
observed.agent_disclosure_fetch_failure: console: '[agent_badge] disclosure fetch failed: fetch error: ...' — the failure is logged rather than swallowed
observed.dead_relay_badge_panel: 'No badges earned yet' — the EMPTY branch, after 18s, well past the store's 5s no-EOSE deadline
observed.expected_on_dead_relay: 'Badges unavailable — Badges could not be read from the relay, so this is not a claim that there are none.'

checks.verdict: PARTIAL — freshness is surfaced and the disclosure fetch failure is reported, but the Unavailable state did not render end-to-end.
checks.finding: The `BadgeListView::Unavailable` branch in components/badge_display.rs and the `BadgeFetchState::Unavailable` deadline in stores/badges.rs are both implemented and unit-tested, and pages/profile.rs does pass a real `state` signal — so the defect is NOT in the code the closeout targeted. On an unreachable relay the store still reaches `Loaded`, which means something upstream reports a successful empty result: most plausibly the relay layer invoking the EOSE callback when the socket is not connected. That is a separate defect in the relay client, and it currently defeats the badge fix at runtime.

incidental_observations: Leptos dev-mode warning on the channel page: 'At crates/nostr-bbs-forum-client/src/pages/channel.rs:87:37, you access a ParamsMap memo outside a reactive tracking context.' The page functions; this is an advisory about a params read that may not re-run on navigation between channels. Pre-existing shape (a `move ||` closure over `use_params_map`), not introduced by the deletion-reconciliation change, but worth a look.

The forum client ignores `window.__ENV__` keys that are not its own: the real names are VITE_RELAY_URL, RELAY_API_URL, AUTH_API_URL, VITE_AUTH_API_URL, POD_API_URL, VITE_POD_API_URL, BBS_ENABLED, BBS_URL, BRAND_LABEL, FORUM_NAME (crates/nostr-bbs-forum-client/src/utils/relay_url.rs). An un-injected build falls back to the production relay, so a local harness that guesses the key names will silently talk to production. Worth a comment in index.html.

governance_response_flow.reason: Same blocker as ADR-091: a governance response is a signed kind-31403 event, and no Schnorr signing is available in this container. The relay-side receipt stages are covered by 14 unit tests with failure injection, the GET /api/governance/receipts route was probed live (HTTP 401 without NIP-98, i.e. the route exists and is gated), and the governance_receipts table was confirmed created on the live local D1 with the full stage/correlation column set.
